hunks.baseline: Breaking through a fierce battlefield where an army numbering in the tens of thousands was locked in combat was nearly impossible.
hunks.sol: Breaking through a fierce battlefield where armies numbering in the tens of thousands were locked in combat was nearly impossible.

hunks.baseline: “Rage forth. Blizzard!”
hunks.sol: “Rage, Blizzard!”

hunks.baseline: “Johnson. Aren’t you pushing yourself too hard? If you keep this up, I can’t just stand by either.”
hunks.sol: “Johnson, aren’t you pushing yourself too hard? If you keep this up, I can’t just stand by either.”

hunks.baseline: If the war hero of the Great Cataclysm and the world’s greatest War Mage and archer unleashed area-of-effect magic of tremendous power and arrows like bolts of lightning…
hunks.sol: If the war hero of the Great Cataclysm and the world’s greatest War Mage and archer unleashed devastating area-of-effect magic and arrows like bolts of lightning…

hunks.baseline: “Long Live The Queen!”
hunks.sol: “Long live the Queen!”

hunks.baseline: “Yeeeeeeah! Let’s gooo!!!”
hunks.sol: “Yeeeeeeah! Let’s gooo!”

hunks.baseline: And if the hundreds of members of the suicide squad who had come this far prepared to make a noble sacrifice advanced as one…
hunks.sol: And if the hundreds of suicide squad members who had come this far prepared to make the ultimate sacrifice advanced as one…

hunks.baseline: It was the last way out that could end the war, and they crossed through the tens of thousands of monsters like a streak of light.
hunks.sol: It was the final path to ending this war, and they crossed through tens of thousands of monsters like a streak of light.

hunks.baseline: The head of a Lycanthrope that had bared its sharp fangs shot into the air, while the limbs of the six-meter-tall boss monster, the Twin-Headed Ogre, were torn apart.
hunks.sol: The head of a Lycanthrope baring its sharp fangs shot into the air, while the limbs of a six-meter-tall boss monster, a Twin-Headed Ogre, were torn from its body.

hunks.baseline: Five Death Knights who had each been commanding a legion appeared and moved to block them, but nothing changed.
hunks.sol: Five Death Knights, each commanding a legion, appeared to block their way, but it made no difference.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung tossed out a single remark.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung tossed out a casual remark.

hunks.baseline: They closed the distance in an instant with only two steps, then swung the sword and spear in their hands without hesitation.
hunks.sol: They closed the distance in only two steps, then swung their sword and spear without hesitation.

hunks.baseline: The first exchange. The Death Knight staggered after blocking the Force that had curved like a whip.
hunks.sol: The first exchange. The Death Knight staggered after blocking the whip-like arc of Force.

hunks.baseline: Its eyes widened at the sight of the magic-infused sword shattering into pieces.
hunks.sol: Its eyes widened as its magic-infused sword shattered into pieces.

hunks.baseline: The upper half of the Death Knight’s body, armor and all, slowly slid away. Between the gaps of its deeply lowered helmet, the light in its eyes flickered like a candle before the wind, then vanished.
hunks.sol: The upper half of the Death Knight’s body, armor and all, slowly slid away. Beneath its low-pulled helmet, the light in its eyes flickered like a candle in the wind, then vanished.

hunks.baseline: Before the bodies of the Death Knights they had each taken responsibility for even touched the ground, Jin Taekyung and Lee Jungryong were already charging toward another enemy.
hunks.sol: Before the Death Knights they had each taken down even hit the ground, Jin Taekyung and Lee Jungryong were already charging toward their next enemies.

hunks.baseline: Wu Heixing joined them a moment late.
hunks.sol: Wu Heixing joined them a moment later.

hunks.baseline: The fate of the three remaining Death Knights was already as good as sealed.
hunks.sol: The fate of the three remaining Death Knights was as good as sealed.

hunks.baseline: The monsters that witnessed their commanders’ destruction instinctively felt fear and retreated.
hunks.sol: The monsters that witnessed their commanders’ destruction instinctively recoiled in fear.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung cut and smashed his way through everything around him as he advanced. Then, at some point, he realized it.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung cut and smashed through everything in his path as he advanced. Then, at some point, he realized it.

hunks.baseline: The monsters that had endlessly blocked their path were nowhere to be seen anymore. Only a ruined road and vast plains stretching out on either side remained.
hunks.sol: The monsters that had endlessly blocked their path were nowhere to be seen. Only a ruined road and vast plains stretching out on either side remained.

hunks.baseline: At the end of them, a city shrouded in thick fog awaited them.
hunks.sol: At the end of the road, a city shrouded in thick fog awaited them.

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong, Wu Heixing, and I raced toward the city where the Arch Lich was waiting.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong, Wu Heixing, and I raced toward the city where the Arch Lich was.

hunks.baseline: —It is to return to my homeland and enjoy a peaceful daily life.
hunks.sol: —To return to my homeland and enjoy a peaceful life.

hunks.baseline: *Ah, sorry. I didn’t mean it like that. So, where is your homeland?*
hunks.sol: *Ah, sorry. I didn’t mean it like that. So where is your homeland?*

hunks.baseline: A monster trying to obtain citizenship. An undead illegal immigrant who had slipped into the country through a Gate, and yet he had no shortage of things to say. His intention was obvious, of course, even if he was going this far.
hunks.sol: A monster trying to obtain citizenship. An undead illegal immigrant who had slipped into the country through a Gate, yet he had no shortage of things to say. His reasons for going this far were obvious, of course.

hunks.baseline: *No.*
hunks.sol: *I don’t want to.*

hunks.baseline: *That’s strange. The more I talk to you, the more I think I’m developing similar symptoms.*
hunks.sol: *That’s strange. The more I talk to you, the more I feel the same symptoms coming on.*

hunks.baseline: *No.*
hunks.sol: *You’re wrong.*

hunks.baseline: As we entered the city, unnaturally thick fog and frigid air greeted us first.
hunks.sol: As we entered the city, the first things to greet us were the ominously thick fog and frigid air.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a familiar energy that I had felt countless times before—but somehow different—brushed across my entire body.
hunks.sol: At the same time, a familiar energy I had felt countless times before—yet somehow different—brushed across my entire body.

hunks.baseline: It was a sticky, unpleasant energy. It did not take me long to realize what it was, and Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing reached the same conclusion.
hunks.sol: Sticky and unpleasant. It did not take me long to realize what the energy was, and Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing reached the same conclusion.

hunks.baseline: “It’s a Gate. I wondered where so many monsters were pouring out from, and now we know. There was a reason for it.”
hunks.sol: “It’s a Gate. I wondered where so many monsters were pouring out from. Now we know why.”

hunks.baseline: Wu Heixing swallowed hard and asked,
hunks.sol: Wu Heixing swallowed hard.

hunks.baseline: As I expected, Wu Heixing looked dumbfounded. Lee Jungryong, however, was different.
hunks.sol: As expected, Wu Heixing looked dumbfounded. Lee Jungryong, however, reacted differently.

hunks.baseline: The emotion in his gaze as he looked at me was clearly a mixture of suspicion and surprise.
hunks.sol: His gaze held a clear mixture of suspicion and surprise.

hunks.baseline: “I just realized it. It was a sensation I felt in North America a very long time ago, during the Great Cataclysm.”
hunks.sol: “I only just realized it. I felt this same sensation a very long time ago, in North America during the Great Cataclysm.”

hunks.baseline: “But it hasn’t happened even once since the Great Cataclysm. How did you know?”
hunks.sol: “But this phenomenon hasn’t occurred even once since the Great Cataclysm. How did you know?”

hunks.baseline: “You had a hunch…”
hunks.sol: “A hunch…”

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong looked at me with an unreadable expression after my firm answer.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong studied me with an unreadable expression after my firm answer.

hunks.baseline: But that was all I could say. Even if I told him the truth, he would not be able to understand it anyway.
hunks.sol: But that was all I could say. Even if I told him the truth, he would not understand it anyway.

hunks.baseline: It was something I had only read about in textbooks—a phenomenon from the distant past.
hunks.sol: It was a phenomenon from the past that I had only ever read about in textbooks.

hunks.baseline: “Gate transformations were rare even during the Great Cataclysm. For one to occur, an extremely powerful monster had to serve as its core and anchor its mana in the area.”
hunks.sol: “Gate transformations were rare even during the Great Cataclysm. For one to occur, an extremely powerful monster must serve as its core and put down roots with its mana.”

hunks.baseline: There was no need to consider which extremely powerful monster that might be.
hunks.sol: There was no need to wonder which extremely powerful monster that might be.

hunks.baseline: I blurted out a single name.
hunks.sol: I blurted out its name.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. It has to be him. He must be contaminating the city with mana and turning it into one enormous Gate. That must also be why he has not shown himself on the battlefield until now.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. It has to be the Arch Lich. It must be contaminating the city with mana and turning it into one enormous Gate. That must also be why it has not appeared on the battlefield until now.”

hunks.baseline: The number of monsters that had revealed themselves on the battlefield so far was close to two hundred thousand.
hunks.sol: Nearly two hundred thousand monsters had appeared on the battlefield so far.

hunks.baseline: That alone was an unprecedented catastrophe. But if the Gate transformation were to be completed…
hunks.sol: That alone was a catastrophe of staggering proportions. But if the Gate transformation were completed…

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong nodded at my words.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong nodded.

hunks.baseline: “We should avoid the monsters as much as possible. We’ll need to conserve even the smallest amount of strength to face him. Mr. Wu, you as well.”
hunks.sol: “We should avoid the monsters whenever possible. We’ll need to conserve every bit of strength we can before facing the Arch Lich. Mr. Wu, that includes you.”

hunks.baseline: Unlike the small city where I had fought Lei Fei last time, this place—the Arch Lich’s stronghold—covered more than ten times the area and still bore traces of having once been a bustling city.
hunks.sol: Unlike the small city where I had fought Lei Fei, this place—the Arch Lich’s stronghold—covered more than ten times the area and still bore traces of its former prosperity.

hunks.baseline: A forest of collapsed skyscrapers. A downtown district that must once have been the most dazzling part of the city, but was now desolate…
hunks.sol: A forest of collapsed skyscrapers. A downtown district that must once have been the most dazzling part of the city, now reduced to desolation…

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong let out a low laugh at my immediate answer.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong let out a low laugh at my immediate reply.

hunks.baseline: “In a sense, perhaps I am. How should I put it? I find myself thinking that you will surpass me someday.”
hunks.sol: “In a sense, perhaps I am. How should I put it? I find myself thinking that someday, you might surpass me.”

hunks.baseline: “You don’t have to worry about that. Even after ten years, I won’t be able to catch up to your heels, Vice Guild Master.”
hunks.sol: “You don’t need to worry about that. Even in ten years, I won’t come close to catching up with you, Vice Guild Master.”

hunks.baseline: “That first blind date was certainly a strange atmosphere.”
hunks.sol: “That first blind date did have a pretty terrible atmosphere.”

hunks.baseline: My memory was not particularly good, but I could still remember my first meeting with him vividly.
hunks.sol: My memory was not particularly good, but I could still vividly remember my first meeting with him.

hunks.baseline: And it seemed Lee Jungryong felt the same way.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong seemed to remember it just as clearly.

hunks.baseline: “We began as enemies bound by a bad fate. The more I think about it, the more regrettable it seems.”
hunks.sol: “Our relationship began with ill fate. The more I think about it, the more regrettable it seems.”

hunks.baseline: “Tell me about it. If we had talked things out from the start instead of cutting someone’s arm off, we might have been able to begin on relatively friendly terms.”
hunks.sol: “Tell me about it. If we had talked things out from the start instead of cutting off someone’s arm, we might have begun on relatively friendly terms.”

hunks.baseline: “Park Jihoon, that boy, made a mistake in the heat of the moment. I apologize.”
hunks.sol: “Park Jihoon made a mistake in the heat of the moment. I apologize.”

hunks.baseline: I watched Lee Jungryong’s back as he moved ahead of us. He leaped between buildings with effortless movements, and I wondered what expression he was wearing now.
hunks.sol: I watched Lee Jungryong’s back as he moved ahead of us. He leaped between buildings with swift, elusive movements, and I wondered what expression he was wearing now.

hunks.baseline: I answered with a snort of laughter.
hunks.sol: I answered with a snort.

hunks.baseline: “Maybe seven years ago? I ate red bean bread as a snack at Hunter training camp. It tasted so good that I cried. But when I ate it after entering society, it wasn’t very good. I haven’t really eaten it since.”
hunks.sol: “Was it about seven years ago? I had a red-bean bun as a snack at the Hunter training center, and it tasted so good I cried. But when I tried one after getting out into the real world, it wasn’t that great. I haven’t really eaten them since.”

hunks.baseline: “So now you’re full?”
hunks.sol: “So now you’ve had your fill?”

hunks.baseline: “I’ve already earned enough for several generations to live without working. My stomach is already full, so what’s the point of forcing more down? I’ll just burst and die.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve already earned enough for several generations to live without working. My stomach is full, so what’s the point of forcing down more? I’ll just burst and die.”

hunks.baseline: “Hmm. Do you happen to suffer from binge-eating disorder?”
hunks.sol: “Hmm. Do you happen to have a binge-eating disorder?”

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong laughed aloud. His fairly loud laughter spread through the thick fog, but he did not seem concerned in the slightest.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong laughed aloud. His booming laughter spread through the thick fog, but he did not seem concerned in the slightest.

hunks.baseline: “Laughter is supposed to bring good fortune, but in this case, don’t you think it might bring monsters instead?”
hunks.sol: “They say laughter brings good fortune, but in this case, don’t you think it might bring monsters instead?”

hunks.baseline: A foul-smelling wind brushed across my entire body.
hunks.sol: A foul-smelling wind swept over us.

hunks.baseline: From building to building. Leaping across gaps of more than twenty meters, we continued running.
hunks.sol: From one building to the next, we continued running, leaping across gaps more than twenty meters wide.

hunks.baseline: We could not sense any monsters, and the buildings around us gradually grew fewer.
hunks.sol: We sensed no sign of monsters, and the buildings around us gradually grew fewer.

hunks.baseline: “Bear with it for a little longer. More importantly, may I ask you one more thing?”
hunks.sol: “Bear with it a little longer. More importantly, may I ask you one more thing?”

hunks.baseline: I looked at Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing in turn before continuing slowly.
hunks.sol: I looked between Lee Jungryong and Wu Heixing before continuing slowly.

hunks.baseline: “He told me not to go.”
hunks.sol: “He told me not to go because it was dangerous.”

hunks.baseline: The smile around Lee Jungryong’s mouth deepened.
hunks.sol: The smile on Lee Jungryong’s lips deepened.

hunks.baseline: I continued with a smile.
hunks.sol: I smiled as I continued.

hunks.baseline: I kept smiling as I went on.
hunks.sol: Still smiling, I went on.

hunks.baseline: “These fucking bastards are more interested in the back of my head than the Arch Lich. That’s what I’m certain of.”
hunks.sol: “I’m certain these fucking bastards are more interested in the back of my head than the Arch Lich.”

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong’s footsteps stopped dead.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong stopped dead.
